title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
abstract: arXiv:2611.26450v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters. We introduce closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained LM weights using zero training examples and zero runtime hooks, while bounding per-layer normalization drift and preserving natural-language (NL) competence. Our construction combines three analytical mechanisms: (1) two-layer Mellin-GLU quadrature over bias-free SwiGLU/GeGLU layers, turning unknown per-token RMSNorm scaling into translation along a log-spaced gate grid ($>250\times$ dynamic range) with IEEE 754 error bounds; (2) cross-token scale cancellation via signed Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE self-sink attention and memoryless SiLU-antisymmetric GatedDeltaNet shifts; and (3) axis-aligned width extension ($d \to d+K$) with $\sqrt{d/(d+K)}$ norm compensation, Base-1

translated_title: LLM内部的CPU：将精确电路零梯度编译进预训练权重
translated_abstract: 预训练语言模型（LM）在没有梯度微调或外部工具解释器的情况下，在精确多位数算术上仍然不可靠。我们提出了闭式、零梯度的电路嫁接原语，可以将确定性计算直接编译进预训练语言模型的权重中，使用零训练样本和零运行时钩子，同时限制每层归一化漂移并保持自然语言能力。我们的构建结合了三种解析机制：（1）在无偏置的SwiGLU/GeGLU层上进行两层Mellin-GLU数值积分，将未知的逐token RMSNorm缩放转换为沿对数间隔门控网格的平移（>250倍动态范围），并具有IEEE 754误差界；（2）通过带符号的Chebyshev不定RoPE自下沉注意力和无记忆的SiLU反对称GatedDeltaNet位移实现跨token缩放消除；（3）采用√(d/(d+K))范数补偿的轴对齐宽度扩展（d → d+K），Base-1...
tldr: 提出了一种零梯度、无需训练样本的闭式电路嫁接方法，可将精确的确定性计算（如多位数算术）直接编译进预训练语言模型权重，同时保持其自然语言能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting method that compiles exact deterministic computation (such as multi-digit arithmetic) directly into pretrained LM weights using no training examples or runtime hooks, while preserving natural-language competence.
